stem: Draw the line passing through the two points $(-2, 3)$ and $(-5, 3)$. Drag the two handles onto these points.
solution: The two points have the same $y$-coordinate, $3$.

hints.text: Read each pair as (x, y): the first number is how far across, the second how far up.
Compare the y-coordinates of the two points, then place each handle at its point.
